home.heroTitle: Plan Uzbek celebrations — from gap circles to weddings
home.heroSubtitle: Coordinate who's coming, where to meet, and who owes what. Weddings, gap circles, sunnat to'y, aqiqa, challari, birthdays, and choyxona nights.
home.heroSubtitleSignedIn: Your weddings, gap circles, sunnat to'y, and more — all in one place.

features.eventsBody: Weddings, gap circles, sunnat to'y, aqiqa, challari, birthdays, or a choyxona gathering — date, place, and guest list in one spot.
features.commentsBody: Threaded comments keep venue picks, tasks, and updates organized as the group decides.
features.expensesBody: Track who paid, split costs fairly, and see balances — useful for gap pools, choyxona bills, and family celebrations.
features.telegramBody: Invite family and friends by link. Get reminders and updates in Telegram.
